dialogue.english: I am Nezha! Let's protect the sea!
dialogue.twFullText: 我是哪吒！一起守護大海！

cards.english: Brave little Nezha lives by the East Sea.
His magic ring and red sash shine bright.

dialogue.english: I will always protect our seaside town!
dialogue.twFullText: 我會一直守護海邊鄉親！

dialogue.english: The magic red sash dances in the wind.

cards.english: One hot day, Nezha plays in the waves.
His red sash shakes the Dragon Palace!
cards.twFullText: 混天綾震動了水晶龍宮！

dialogue.english: Haha! The cool sea water feels great!
Whoa! Why is our Crystal Palace shaking?
dialogue.twFullText: 呀！水晶龍宮怎麼搖晃啦？

cards.english: Dragon Prince Ao Bing rides out in anger.
Nezha stops him with his magic red sash!

dialogue.english: Stop! How dare you shake our palace!
dialogue.twFullText: 住手！竟敢震動我們龍宮！

dialogue.english: I was just playing! Don't bully people!
dialogue.twFullText: 我只是玩水，不許欺負人！

cards.english: The Dragon King brings dark storm waves.
cards.twFullText: 東海龍王掀起滔天大浪。

cards.english: Chentang Pass is in terrible danger!

dialogue.english: Surrender now, or I will flood the town!
dialogue.twFullText: 快出來認錯，否則水淹全城！

dialogue.english: Don't hurt the town! I will face you!

cards.english: To save the town, Nezha steps forward.
cards.twFullText: 為救鄉親，哪吒勇敢站出。

cards.english: He fades into glowing pink lotus petals.
cards.twFullText: 他化作滿天發光蓮花瓣。

dialogue.english: Stay safe, everyone! The storm will stop.
dialogue.twFullText: 大家平安就好，風浪會停的。

dialogue.english: Pure pink petals carry his brave heart.
dialogue.twFullText: 發光蓮瓣載著他的勇敢之心。

cards.english: Master Taiyi revives Nezha with a lotus.
cards.twFullText: 太乙真人用仙蓮救活他。

cards.english: He gifts the Fire Spear and Wind Wheels!
cards.twFullText: 還賜予火尖槍和風火輪！

dialogue.english: Rise again, brave Lotus Hero of the Sea!
dialogue.twFullText: 醒來吧，勇敢的蓮花小英雄！

dialogue.english: Thank you, Master! Now I will save everyone!
dialogue.twFullText: 謝謝師父！我回去守護大家！

cards.english: Nezha flies back on blazing Wind Wheels.
cards.twFullText: 哪吒踏風火輪沖破烏雲。

cards.english: His Fire Spear parts the giant waves!

dialogue.english: Dragon King, promise to bring peace now!
dialogue.twFullText: 龍王，快答應不再傷害百姓！

dialogue.english: I yield! I will send gentle rain forever!
dialogue.twFullText: 我認輸！今後一定風調雨順！

cards.english: Bright rainbows arch over the calm sea.
cards.twFullText: 彩虹高掛在平靜的東海。

cards.english: Everyone cheers for brave little Nezha!
cards.twFullText: 鄉親們歡呼感謝小哪吒！

dialogue.english: Peace is back! Let's enjoy the sunny sea!
dialogue.twFullText: 大海恢復平靜啦！大家開心吧！

dialogue.english: Warm sunlight and gentle rain bless the town.
dialogue.twFullText: 風調雨順，海邊永遠平安。
